chunks.title: BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) (BNDES) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) is a National Development Bank headquartered in Brazil. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Announced $300M GCF mobilization + $147M IBRD/CIF forest restoration + $1B IDB/IBRD industrial decarbonization LOI at COP31. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: R$39B ($6.9B) climate investment push anchored by $300M GCF (Flying Rivers Capital, Just Climate Brasil) + $147M IBRD/CIF forest restoration. Source verification: https://carbon-pulse.com/571307/.

chunks.title: BNDES Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) provides the following climate financing instruments: Development Loan, Climate Fund Equity Anchor, Blended Concessional Finance, Green Credit Line. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 300,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Fund Manager, Municipality.

chunks.title: BNDES Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank): Nature-Based Solutions & Forestry, Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Sustainable Fuels, Bioeconomy. Target geographic focus includes: Brazil, Latin America. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: BNDES Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete BNDES's application form: Brazilian operating entity / Climate Call alignment; GCF / IBRD / CIF environmental & forest-protection safeguards; Verified carbon abatement or reforestation hectares; Brazilian regulatory & environmental licensing. Explicit exclusion rules: Illegal deforestation; Coal power. Official application portal: https://www.bndes.gov.br/.

chunks.title: BNDES Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: BNDES (Brazilian Development Bank) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
